label: Town of Coventry
header:
# Town of Coventry municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Coventry official website, Select Board page: 'Select Board members: Kerry Keement, Chair; Dan Webster; Matt Maxwell.' The town's Town Contacts page prints the same three.

Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 election of Matthew Maxwell to a 3-year Selectboard term (51 votes). A 2026 article to increase the board from three to five members failed (37-35), so the board remains three. The Secretary of State directory (June 5, 2026) publishes only Maxwell's name for Coventry; the town's own roster governs.
Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record 'Town Moderator -- Matthew Maxwell -- Elected' at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (1-year term).
Town of Coventry, 2023 Annual Report, 'Elected Officials' table (coventryvt.org): lists the Town Clerk, Deb Tanguay (term to 2025), among the town's elected officials.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Deb Tanguay as Town Clerk of Coventry.
Town of Coventry official website, Town Clerk page: 'Deb Tanguay, CMC, CVC -- Coventry Town Clerk.'
Town of Coventry official website, Town Treasurer page: 'The Town Treasurer is hired by the Select Board' and names David Barlow as Treasurer. The holder is recorded as appointed.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists David Barlow as Town Treasurer of Coventry.
Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 election of Deb Tanguay as Delinquent Tax Collector (68 votes, 1-year term).
Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 election of Donald Grondin as First Constable (1-year term).
Town of Coventry official website, Constables page: 'First Constable -- Donald "Pedro" Grondin.'
Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 election of Israel Sanville as Second Constable (1-year term).
Town of Coventry official website, Constables page: 'Second Constable -- Israel Sanville.'
Town of Coventry official website, Cemetery Commission page ('2025 Cemetery Commission Members'): 'Chair -- Daniel Rondeau; Vice-Chair -- Renee Fortin; Secretary -- Alyssa Conn.'
Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 election of Alyssa Conn as Cemetery Commissioner (2-year term).

Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 election of Praneet Menon as Trustee of Cemetery Funds (1-year term); the office is distinct from the Trustees of Public Funds, for which Coventry elects no officer.
Town of Coventry, 2023 Annual Report, 'Elected Officials' table (coventryvt.org): lists 'Trustee of Cemetery Funds -- Praneet Menon' among the elected officials.
Town of Coventry, 2026 annual meeting warning, Article 3: elects two Planning Commission members by Australian ballot (2-year terms) -- Coventry's Planning Commission is an elected body.
Town of Coventry official website, Planning Commission page: Amanda Hussey (Chair), Stephanie Rondeau, Pedro Grondin, Carver Maxwell, and Israel Sanville.
Town of Coventry, 2026 Town Annual Meeting Minutes (coventryvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 election of Amanda Hussey and Donald Grondin as Planning Commission members.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Coventry justices of the peace: Anita Allen, Sherylin Bradley, Melissa Gallup, Donald P Hunt, Kerry L Keement, Edward R Lovejoy, and Richard Lussier.

The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
